sloka: कान्चना जल कुम्भाः च भद्र पीठम् स्वलम्क्Rतम् ।काञ्चना जलकुमाभश्च भद्रपीठं स्वलङ्कृतम् ॥२-१५-४॥
transliteration: kāncanā jala kumbhāḥ ca bhadra pīṭham svalamkRtam ।kāñcanā jalakumābhaśca bhadrapīṭhaṁ svalaṅkṛtam ॥2-15-4॥

translations.english: Golden jars filled with water, the welldecorated throne and a chariot spread well with bright tigerskin (were kept ready).
